<?php
// Isolated browser preview only. This file is never included in the theme ZIP.
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$admin=username_exists('hrms_admin');
if (!$admin) { $admin=wp_insert_user(array('user_login'=>'hrms_admin','user_pass'=>'CheckHRMS2026!','display_name'=>'Super Admin','role'=>'administrator')); }
if (is_wp_error($admin)) { throw new Exception('Could not create the preview administrator.'); }
wp_set_current_user($admin);
dip_company_install();
list($workspace,$raw)=dip_ref_read();
foreach (array('emps','att','leaves','reim','ann','mt','ts','tk','run','snap','attendanceHistory') as $key) {
    if (!empty($workspace['data'][$key])) { throw new Exception('Open this Blueprint in a fresh Playground instance. Existing records were not changed.'); }
}
$data=$workspace['data'];
$data['co']['name']='Dream India Production';
$data['co']['tag']='HR and Payroll';
$data['brand']=dip_brand_validate(array_merge(dip_brand_defaults(),array('primary'=>'#16a34a','sidebar'=>'dark')));
$result=dip_ref_commit($workspace,$raw,dip_ref_validate($data,$workspace['data']));
if (is_wp_error($result)) { throw new Exception('Could not initialise the fresh company.'); }
$owner=username_exists('company_admin');
if (!$owner) { $owner=wp_insert_user(array('user_login'=>'company_admin','user_pass'=>'CompanyAdmin2026!','display_name'=>'Company Admin','role'=>'dreampeople_hr_manager')); }
if (is_wp_error($owner)) { throw new Exception('Could not create the company administrator.'); }
global $wpdb;
list($companies,$members)=dip_company_tables();
if ($wpdb->replace($members,array('company_id'=>1,'user_id'=>$owner,'role'=>'owner'),array('%d','%d','%s'))===false) { throw new Exception('Could not link the company administrator.'); }
if (!dip_license_read(1)) {
    $license=dip_license_validate(array('plan'=>'Business','cycle'=>'monthly','fee'=>49900,'maxStaff'=>25,'status'=>'active','validUntil'=>''));
    $license['revision']=1; add_option(dip_license_key(1),$license,'',false);
}
update_user_meta($admin,'hrms_active_company',1);
update_user_meta($owner,'hrms_active_company',1);
update_option('blogname','All in One HRMS');
echo 'Fresh company ready: no employees, attendance or payroll records. Super Admin and Company Admin preview logins configured.';
